title: Lipstick & Boots | 3-Story Condo | King Bed
description:
Lipstick & Boots blends style and space across three private levels in West End: a King suite with private bath, a Queen suite with workspace and bath, and an open-concept social floor with chef's kitchen and coffee bar. Enjoy private 2-car garage parking (skip the $40/night Broadway fees), statement mirrors and lighting for getting ready, and a spot 10 minutes from Vanderbilt, Centennial Park, and West End's best brunch. Professionally hosted with organic cleaning supplies and 24/7 support.

The space
The Layout for Groups:
⬥ 3rd Floor (The Royal Retreat): A massive King bed, single fold-away, and private en-suite bathroom. Total privacy at the top.
⬥ 2nd Floor (The Suite): Two Queen beds, a single fold-away, a dedicated workspace/desk, and a private en-suite bathroom.
⬥ 1st Floor (The Social Hub): Open-concept living with a chef’s kitchen, coffee bar (grinder + fresh beans), and a sleeper sofa for extra guests.

Why You’ll Love It:
⬥ Secure Parking: Private access to an undercover garage with 2 dedicated spots. Skip the $40/night Broadway or $60 hotel parking fees.
⬥ The Glam Factor: High-end mirrors and lighting make this the perfect spot for getting ready before a night at the Honky Tonks.
⬥ Walkability: 10 minutes to Vanderbilt, Centennial Park, and West End’s best brunch spots (Maggiano’s, BrickTop’s).

Guest access
Enjoy full, private access to the entire condo, in-unit laundry, and a secured garage via a 100% contactless digital lock code.

Other things to note
To ensure a secure stay, we will send a quick digital sign-off link immediately after your booking. Simply complete this brief check-in form to automatically release your full arrival instructions and property access codes prior to your check-in date.

Early Check-In:
We take pride in our 5-star cleaning standards. Because our professional crews need the full window to prepare the estate, early check-ins are not guaranteed and must be requested by messaging us.
